findings.problem: The hint 'you all, as the object' doesn't rule out the formal plural Sie (Ich rufe Sie später an), so it allows a second right answer.
findings.fix: hint: you all, informal, as the object

back.target: you (plural, informal; accusative or dative object pronoun of ihr)

note: Using ihr/euch is fine here because the card is about the plural pronoun itself; anrufen takes the accusative, and euch is the same in accusative and dative.
